description: WS4 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. The pr.yml lint job runs ~15 independent guards sequentially and stops at the first failure, so a PR with multiple guard misses pays one full CI cycle (plus a triage wake) per discovery: fix ruff, push, discover timing-policy, push, discover compat-docs... Restructure so every independent guard runs with continue-on-error: true (locally: accumulate exit codes), then one aggregator step fails the job if any guard failed and writes a consolidated pass/fail table to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Guards stay individually visible in the UI; the round-trip count for multi-guard misses drops to 1. Mirror the same accumulate-then-fail structure in the ci-lint make target.

anti_patterns.dont: Let the aggregator read step outcomes by hand-listing step ids
anti_patterns.instead: Derive the guard set programmatically (steps context iteration or a naming convention checked by the parity test)
anti_patterns.why: New guards would silently escape aggregation

anti_patterns.dont: Merge all guards into one opaque mega-script step
anti_patterns.instead: Keep one step per guard with continue-on-error + a final aggregator
anti_patterns.why: Loses per-guard visibility and step-level timing in the Actions UI

preserves.behavior: Each guard's individual pass/fail remains visible per-step in the Actions UI
The lint job remains a required (blocking) member of ci-required-result - aggregation must not soften the gate

verifications.description: Parity test still passes after restructure
Local mirror reports multiple failures in one run (inject two trivial guard breaks in a scratch branch, observe both reported)
verifications.expected: both injected failures listed, exit nonzero

work_units.summary: Re-validate evidence: recount the pr.yml lint job's independent guard steps and confirm the job is still fail-fast sequential on current develop
Restructure pr.yml lint job: per-guard continue-on-error + aggregator step with GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY table
Mirror accumulate-then-fail in the ci-lint make recipe (report all failing guards, exit nonzero once)
Update/verify the ci-lint parity pin test against the restructured job
